messages:
sofia: heads up — i'm proposing an "allowlist exemptions" flow for inspect-mode captures. idea: a small set of routes can opt into full request+response logs for debugging, but with strict controls (approval, TTL, access audit). :eyes:

mike: can you sketch the constraints? e.g., retention, who can flip the switch, sampling?

sofia: short version: 1) UI requires 2 approvers (eng + product) 2) temporary window (max 48h) 3) captured data stored encrypted with KMS and access logged 4) auto-truncate PII by default unless approved per-route 5) strong audit trail + alerting on access

elaine: is the intention to let SREs/SEs enable this in prod on-demand, or only via solicited support flows?

sofia: both. primary is on-demand but gated — support can request via console which triggers approvals and records justification. emergency breakglass path exists but must be ratified post-hoc (ops-bot ticket).

zhang: technical Q: how do we do redaction? current scrubber is heuristic and sometimes ruins debugging. if we allow "full" capture, we need a way to mask keys (api keys, emails) but keep context tokens. maybe offer two modes: full-binary for matching hashes + redact-only-known-PII?

mike: agree. propose: store two artifacts — a redacted copy for long-term retention (30d) and an ephemeral unredacted blob (48h) accessible only to approvers. ephemeral gets auto-deleted.

sofia: exact. impl notes: ephemeral lives in a dedicated S3 bucket with separate KMS key and lifecycle rule, and only roles in the "inspect-approver" group get kms:Decrypt for that key. access via console with MFA prompt. ops-bot will log every retrieval.

sam: perf/telemetry note — capturing full payloads will blow up log volume. we need sampling + quota. suggest default sampling 1/100 for high-traffic routes, and 1/10 for low-traffic. console should show estimated token/storage cost before enabling.

elaine: +1 on UI cost estimate. product wants a clear "cost to enable" banner and expected disk usage. also we need a soft quota — after X GB captured per-org per-week, auto-disable and notify billing.

mike: implementation sketch for routing: annotate routes with metadata {inspect_allowed: true, default_sampling: 0.01, pii_sensitivity: "high|medium|low"}. sampling happens at ingress; if sampled, attach trace id and route to capture pipeline.

zhang: about redaction heuristics: i'd like a small DSL for scrubbing rules per-route (regex + named-capture -> mask strategy). store rule revisions in repo so it's auditable. if rule mismatch can be flagged by QA to request ephemeral replay.

legal: quick flag from legal: any full-capture of user-provided data needs explicit consent or opt-in for customer-controlled data. for enterprise customers we must surface capture in contract and provide per-tenant opt-out. also PIIs like SSNs must be blocked by default.

sofia: noted. we will add tenant-level toggle and require signed opt-in. also default deny of sensitive patterns (SSN / credit card) unless clear business justification and legal sign-off.

sam: rollout plan idea: 1) internal canary (eng + se) for 2 weeks 2) beta with 3 customers who sign NDA + terms 3) GA with console guardrails and billing limits. instrumentation: add metrics for captures_count, capture_bytes, retrieval_count, and alert on spikes.

mike: for the console UX: make "Enable capture" a two-step modal: choose routes, sampling, TTL, justification text, required approvers. show cost estimate. after enabling, add a persistent banner on that route's page saying "capture enabled — expires in 36h" with quick disable button.

elaine: tiny UX ask: make it easy to attach a link to the customer ticket so auditors can see why it was enabled. also a checkbox for "post-hoc legal review required".

sofia: ops-bot will create a ticket automatically with the justification and approver annotations. retrieval workflow will append access logs to that ticket.

infra-bot: deployment note — we need a feature flag gate (ff:inspect_allowlist) and schema changes for route metadata in config-service. will create a migration PR.

zhang: one more: support replaying ephemeral capture into a sandbox model runner for recreating issues. must be sandboxed and recorded. need opt-out for customers who disallow replay.

legal: add replay to contract language. approval required per-tenant.

sofia: next actions: mike/zhang draft RFC for the route metadata + scrub DSL; sam to propose metrics + sampling defaults; product to draft console flows; legal to draft contract language. i'll coordinate and set a sync. sound good? :thumbsup:

mike: sounds good. i'll start the RFC.

zhang: drafting scrub DSL now, will push examples.

elaine: will design the modal and banner in figma and link here when ready.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-3247: "inspect allowlist flow — approvals, retention, audit" (assigned: sofia, due: 2024-05-10).

sofia: thanks all, i'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to walk through RFC outlines.

sam: thanks — one thing to watch: alert fatigue. prefer fewer noisy alerts and a weekly digest plus emergency spikes email.

mike: noted. we'll include alert thresholds in the RFC.

sofia: closing for now, will ping when docs are up.
